title: Ponte Giuseppe Mazzini
scope: Complete Ponte Giuseppe Mazzini: three open segmental stone arches, two rounded river piers with waterline bases and projecting springing caps, ashlar spandrels, pale travertine arch rings and cornice, broad road with raised verge walks, pierced circular stone parapets and green-patinated ornamental lamps with small rostral scroll forms. Preserve the complete mapped crossing and both independent riverside routes beneath the outer spans.
heightPolicy: Fixed10m standard terrain datum; road endpoints23m and center23.25m. Three circular-segment arch intrados rise from14.2m at springing to20.7m at their crowns. Exterior heights, supports and lamps are ordinary-picture approximations; original standard terrain and the actual native river/route surfaces determine fit.
limitations: Original ordinary-picture medium-fi approximation, not a surveyed engineering or conservation model. ColdShine’s2007 lower-lungotevere photograph controls the three open arches, rounded piers and pierced parapet. Lubin23’s lamp close-up controls the patinated shaft, globe and small rostral scroll silhouette. Heraldic relief, inscriptions and individual carved figures are simplified rather than copied as photo textures.
